[SWS_Fr_00540] ⌈The function Fr_DisableLPdu() shall perform the following tasks
on FlexRay CC Fr_CtrIdx:
1. Figure out the physical resource (e.g., a buffer) mapped to the processing of the
FlexRay frame identified by Fr_LpduIdx.
2. Configure the physical resource (a buffer) in a way that it doesn’t take part in the
transmission/reception process.
3. Return E_OK.
⌋
